name: Custom Shape Wooden Rotating Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: 
    This rotating photo frame is crafted entirely from premium-quality wood:
    - Display Frame (Part 1): Made of 6 layers of sturdy 3mm wooden boards.
    - Inner Rotating Board (Part 2): Built from 3 layers of 3mm wood and designed to rotate smoothly.
    - Wooden Base (Part 3): A durable 2-layer wooden stand (each 3mm thick) that ensures stability.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 
    - Overall size: 5 × 5 inches ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
    - Designed in a custom shape to fit personalized photos while maintaining a compact, decorative display size suitable for desks, shelves, and bedside tables.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology: 
    - Printed using high-resolution UV printing, ensuring vivid, sharp, long-lasting images.
    - The product is double-sided printed, allowing you to showcase a photo on one side and text or artwork on the opposite side.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - The inner board can rotate 360°, making it perfect for switching between photos or designs with a simple spin.
    - Acts as a personalized home décor piece, desk display, keepsake, or photo memento.
    - Easy to assemble and stable on flat surfaces thanks to its solid wooden base.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    This customizable rotating photo frame makes a meaningful gift for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, weddings, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, or any special moment. Suitable for family members, partners, friends, and colleagues, it brings warmth and personalization to any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xCustom Shape Wooden Rotating Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
